viewed_photos: Bob Klips stars and stems, June6 2013
findings: Upright leafy shoots form variable-height turf, 15-28 cm. Reviewed capsule photo but excluded capsules from vegetative spring geometry. Leaves collapse into columns at 25 mm without invented oversized stars. Actually compared reference photographs, current seeds 1, 4, 7 and all 36 seeded variants. Accepted as coarse colony-scale spring geometry, not close-up botanical microdetail. Variant endorsement remains a user decision.
